name: bicycle-routes-generator-mcp
description: Generates mountain bike and road cycling routes on real OpenStreetMap trails and roads and saves them as GPX with elevation.
long_description: Ask Claude for a route (for example: "a ~25 km MTB loop from El Papiol, little climbing, on dirt tracks" or "a 60 km road bike loop with little traffic"). The track is computed by the BRouter engine on real trails; Claude never invents coordinates. It returns distance, climbing, maximum grade, paved/track/singletrack percentages and warnings (traffic, grades over 12 %, protected areas, forbidden access) and saves the GPX in the folder you choose. Climbing from an elevation model may differ from a barometric watch: always check the route before riding. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

tools.name: generate_route
tools.description: Generates an MTB or road cycling route (loop or point-to-point, optionally through via points) on real trails or roads, saves it as GPX and returns the summary and warnings.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Lists the saved GPX routes with their summary.

gpx_dir.title: GPX folder
gpx_dir.description: Where routes are saved (default /tmp/bicycle-routes; macOS empties /tmp on restart, so copy routes you want to keep). The extension only writes to this folder (and its hidden .bicycle-routes subfolder with cache and index).

contact.title: Contact email or website
contact.description: Sent with requests to OpenStreetMap services (Nominatim and Overpass), as their usage policy requires. Not shared with anyone else.

engine.title: Routing engine
engine.description: brouter (recommended, no key) or ors (OpenRouteService, needs a key).

brouter_url.title: BRouter server
brouter_url.description: Public server by default. If you run your own: http://localhost:17777

ors_api_key.title: OpenRouteService API key
ors_api_key.description: Only if you choose the ors engine. Free at openrouteservice.org.

protected_areas.title: Warn about protected areas
protected_areas.description: Queries the Overpass API (OpenStreetMap) to find out whether the route crosses natural parks or reserves.
